ios.desc:
Create quotes, invoices and bills, capture expenses and receipts, receive payments, reconcile bank transactions and use JAX, your AI finance partner on-the-go - all within Xero's AI-powered Accounting App. Your mobile subscription includes access to Xero's full suite of accounting and bookkeeping features on the web: profit and loss reporting, integrated apps and more.

Xero is accounting software trusted by 5 million+ small businesses and sole traders worldwide.

~

Features:

MANAGE INVOICING ON THE GO
• Raise & send quotes for faster client approval & get started on the job sooner
• Reduce the time it takes to get paid by raising & sending invoices from your device as soon as the job is completed
• Send invoices directly to clients via email, text message or other apps
• Easily keep track of unpaid invoices, to see who owes you what - and even track the status of an invoice, seeing if it has been viewed by clients
• For US users, automatically calculate sales tax on invoices for any state or jurisdiction

AI-POWERED FINANCE PARTNER
• Get instant answers on your financial performance — revenue and profit trends, or your current cash position
• Create, edit, approve and send a quote or invoice, and get answers to invoice-related questions
• Snap a photo or upload a document to get instant, secure answers and summaries
• Ask JAX how to use a Xero feature, and get answers based on Xero Central's help content

MANAGE SPEND
• Record spend as soon as it happens to reduce office admin & time spent looking for lost receipts

MANAGE CUSTOMER & SUPPLIER INFORMATION
• Have vital contact information in the palm of your hand so you can do business from wherever you are
• Get a view of how much is owed and quickly add notes so you can build better business relationships

RECONCILE FROM ANYWHERE
• Good bookkeeping habits have been made easy - Smart matches, rules & suggestions makes reconciling your business transactions easy, from anywhere with a few simple clicks
• Filter bank statement lines to optimise your unique workflow, leading to faster reconciliation
• New sort & search tools to make it easier to view business transactions & streamline the reconciliation process

ACCEPT CONTACTLESS PAYMENTS RIGHT ON YOUR iPhone
(currently only available in the US, Australia, the UK, New Zealand & Canada)
• Accept in-person, contactless payments right on your iPhone, so you can reach new customers & take payments on-the-go
• Accept contactless payments from physical debit/cred
